# Inherited baseline qualification

The pinned v6.2 source is the implementation starting point, not a promise that its packaging assumptions remain valid. The adjacent inherited-baseline-qualification.v1.json enumerates all 19 Python bootstrap files and 125 named test functions, five TypeScript bootstrap/vendor files, the Python canonical rejection file, and seven source consumers requiring semantic adaptation. Its task owners supplement literal MIG0-T03 path rebinding. Every listed test remains collected; preserve every parameterized negative. No skip, xfail, renamed-away obligation or blanket exclusion closes this contract.

## Exact current and historical inputs

The two fixture rows specify original absolute source paths, size and SHA-256 plus exact plan destinations. During plan authoring those bytes are supplied in docs/fixtures/inherited/v6.2; BOOT0 seeds them into pack/docs/fixtures/inherited/v6.2 and MIG0-T04 vendors them under vendor/hybrid-discovery-v6.3.6/docs/fixtures/inherited/v6.2. Runtime and reviewers read only these supplied copies. The historical task registry is data: never execute its argv, use its paths as authority, or treat its 51-task count as the successor count. The historical PlanManifest is used only with its inherited schema to exercise historical authority mutations.

Resolve historical records against the existing inherited namespace:

| Consumer | Exact replacement input |
|---|---|
| test_repository_baseline.py historical PlanManifest test | runtime vendor docs/fixtures/inherited/v6.2/plan-manifest.json with runtime vendor schemas/meta-records.schema.json |
| test_repository_baseline.py root hash golden test | runtime vendor vectors/repo0-baseline-roots-v1.json |

| Current normative checks | explicit pack root plus runtime root and docs/registries/normative-source-map.v1.json |

Here “runtime vendor” means the explicit runtime root plus vendor/hybrid-discovery-v6.3.6. Test helpers receive runtime/pack roots explicitly; no authoring absolute root survives baseline replay or isolated review. Do not create old pack/docs/schemas or pack/docs/vectors aliases to conceal an invalid consumer. Fixture data and actual successor authority must never share an implicit default path.

## Successor consumers and preserved checks

MIG0-T04 adapts tools/sync_pack_assets.py, src/moj_discovery/vendor.py, tests/bootstrap/test_schema_vendor.py, extension/test/schema-vendor.test.ts and tools/verify_normative_bundle.py. Keep the sync_pack_assets(pack, root, check=False) public interface while applying the exact normative map. All old security checks remain: source/destination symlink, hardlink, FIFO, non-NFC and noncanonical-mode rejection; exact file-set detection; nested manifest names remain payload. Test fixtures must supply an explicit miniature mapping containing every fixture source. Any stale-output test operates only in its disposable test directory under explicit fixture authority; production copy/check behavior follows the no-deletion boundary. Root command-registry creation stays MIG0-T05-owned; sync checks validate its mapped location without acquiring another creation owner.

verify_normative_bundle(pack, runtime) and its --pack/--runtime CLI check the current normative map, mapped schema references, mapped CDP bytes, current registry equality and the current plan contract. It must not infer runtime from pack.parent.parent, require a historical SourceProvenance record from the successor, or validate the successor PlanManifest with the v6.2 schema. The historical PlanManifest and registry are separately hash-verified fixture inputs. Source fixture hashes cannot establish current candidate readiness.

P01-T01 adapts tools/verify_toolchains.py and tests/bootstrap/test_toolchains.py to the exact supplied successor pyproject/test/build configuration. Preserve the pinned Python/Node/uv/pnpm tuple, exact dependencies, range/extra-dependency negatives, config-drift negatives and resolved-version negatives. MIG0-T07 alone creates/refreshed native locks and updates their explicit trusted binding; the verifier cannot bless a lock by hashing arbitrary bytes it was handed. Compare native lock versions to the pinned baseline and the resulting hashes to the MIG0 receipt. The old hardcoded testpaths=[tests/bootstrap] comparison must not reject the new required discovery configuration.

P02-T01 adapts governance.validate_task_dependencies and its graph test to the successor task manifest, declared count, unique IDs and transitive DAG checks. Do not parse the command registry as a 51-task manifest. Keep every graph partition/closed-shape/order mutation unchanged: the executable/future graph semantics remain the pinned ones.

P05-T02 adapts governance.validate_canonical_registry and test_schema_closure.py. Keep the inherited 83 domains, 65 exclusions, 18 no-exclusion bindings, all schema-bound constraints, protocol URNs and golden hashes. Resolve the historical TaskCommandRegistry binding only through its pinned fixture. The 12 inherited command IDs listed in inherited_command_obligations must each have the exact successor command coverage shown there. This table is evidence mapping, not an executable alias. Missing historical ID, missing successor command, missing verifier symbol, dropped vector, bad fixture hash or unresolved schema is an error. New successor schema validation remains independently required.

P05-T09 adapts tools/run_command_registry.py, src/moj_discovery/pack_verifier.py, test_command_registry.py and the successor-classified functions in test_repository_baseline.py. The new command runner needs current closed-schema parsing, exact argv/cwd/environment, deterministic execution order and approved evidence destinations. Tests must not access baseline_result_contract, verification_commands or tasks/additional_argv on the new registry. Preserve the behavioral obligations of each named test: execution of every declared command, wrong-output rejection, shell/glob/placeholder rejection, exact environment, separate stdout/stderr matching, error-token boundaries/multiplicity, source stability before/after execution, closed shapes, duplicate IDs, candidate-tree path safety, and no accepted result on blocked execution. Replace legacy “primary plus additional” fixture syntax with two explicit registered commands; preserve order and execute each once.

Successor repository tests exercise actual zero-parent Git identity, current command-result/receipt binding, stale/tampered results, malformed timestamp/size/boolean fields, hardlinks, ambient Git rejection and failure without overwriting evidence. They cannot accept a historical v6.2 receipt as current proof. Exact root and output bindings must work in both authoring qualification and final baseline locations. The historical archive/hash functions listed individually in the registry continue using their immutable v6.2 fixtures, including the exact 760-byte ZIP golden and its SHA-256. Keep their security negatives; their success establishes protocol compatibility only. Current seal/release tests separately qualify the new archive and attestation contract.

The other Python bootstrap and TypeScript bootstrap files retain inherited protocol semantics while executing against the successor source/vendor root. In particular bootstrap_self_check stays inert with production NONE; its local NO does not override a later separately qualified readiness record. Capability, CDP, authorization, scope, custody, DDL, durability, clock and semantic-denial coverage cannot be removed as a migration shortcut.

## Qualification and evidence

The registry supplies exact argv arrays for QUALIFY_INHERITED_BOOTSTRAP_PY, QUALIFY_INHERITED_BOOTSTRAP_TS, QUALIFY_INHERITED_CANONICAL_PY, QUALIFY_SUCCESSOR_NORMATIVE_BINDINGS and QUALIFY_SUCCESSOR_REGISTRY_SELF_CHECK. They are registered with P05-T09 and repeat them in candidate and final-baseline replay after all declared adaptations. Compile TypeScript immediately before its qualification; argv enumerates actual .js files, never a directory or glob. No historical registry argv is executed.

P06 test-discovery validation must compare the 125 named baseline functions and every baseline parameter expansion to the collected successor suite. Report fixture/protocol compatibility and actual successor behavior as separate results. Record a positive migrated source/layout case plus negatives for every missing old consumer, bad root, stale config/lock binding, historical receipt substitution, missing inherited-command coverage and missing test. Qualification fails if a required test is absent or skipped even when the test process exits zero. No provider access, installation, production authority or runtime implementation was executed by this plan-authoring contract.
